messages:
nina: Heads up folks  starting a short manager checklist for the new growth PM joining next Monday. Putting essentials here so managers have a repeatable 1-week plan.

omar: Awesome, thanks. Can we keep it compact? Past threads are long.

nina: Yep  compact version below (copy/paste into your invites). Also adding a measurable 30/60/90 skeleton that managers can adapt.

nina: Manager one-week checklist (compact):
- Before start: confirm device shipped + tracking, Okta group created, GitHub invite sent, Slack channels pre-joined. Assign a buddy.
- Day1 AM: 30m manager 1:1 (welcome + expectations), 30m team intro, 15m buddy meet.
- Day1 PM: environment smoke test with buddy (git, build, tokens).
- Days 2-4: two stakeholder 1:1s (eng lead, analytics), product deep-dive (top RFCs), small scoped task to close.
- Day5: review 30/60/90 draft together; set 3 clear 30-day outcomes.

nina: Quick escalation: if >2 access items remain open after Day1, escalate to IT and People Ops.

it-bot: Laptop order RD-20245 shows 'in transit'. Okta group request received (req-429). See https://redwood.internal/onboard/20245.

samir: 30/60/90 skeleton (outcome-focused):
30 days: access verified; read 3 customer cases; deliver a documented quick win (doc or small bug). Success = all permissions + quick win merged/published.
60 days: lead a small experiment from spec to QA. Success = rollout plan + metrics.
90 days: own a roadmap slice and measure impact. Success = before/after metric + retrospective.

kelly: Where to store the draft? We put them in Confluence in the People Ops team space under "new-hire milestones"; managers can keep a private draft then move it there after review.

omar: Perfect. I'll paste this into our team checklist and set calendar invites. Thanks Nina!

nina: Thanks all  ping here if anything stalls. I'll add a short Confluence template link once I format it.
